events.title: Paul Dempsey – Shotgun Karaoke
events.description: Paul Dempsey performs his unique "Shotgun Karaoke" show at Kings Beach Tavern, a popular live music destination known for its regular entertainment acts in the Beach Bar.

events.title: Chris Webb and The Sweaty Palms – Live in the Beer Garden
events.description: Enjoy an afternoon of live music with Chris Webb and The Sweaty Palms in the Beer Garden of the Banana Bender Pub. Expect good food and a vibrant pub atmosphere.

events.title: Noosa Chorale – Monday Night Rehearsals
events.description: Join the Noosa Chorale's weekly rehearsal for their upcoming jazz and blues concerts. New singers are welcome to this recurring community group, no auditions required.

events.title: U3A Noosa Friday Talk – Muhammad: The Founder of Islam
events.description: Darrel Roche presents a talk on Muhammad, the founder of Islam, as part of U3A Noosa's regular Friday Talks series. New members are welcome to attend this intellectually engaging session.

events.title: Climate Ready Community: The Adaptation Game Workshop
events.description: An interactive workshop where participants play "The Adaptation Game" to explore real-world climate challenges and collaborate on solutions with other locals. Designed for curious minds interested in community resilience.

events.title: Solbar – Live Music (Various Acts)
events.description: Solbar, a premium live music venue, hosts various acts typically from Wednesday to Sunday. Check their website for the full weekly lineup of ticketed and free gigs.

events.title: Old Ways, New Marks | First Nations Screenprint Collective Exhibition
events.description: This exhibition at Caloundra Regional Gallery features works by the First Nations Screenprint Collective, exploring traditional and contemporary art forms. It's a meaningful art experience running throughout June.

events.title: Eumundi Markets – Live Music & Community
events.datetime: Wed 17 Jun & Sat 20 Jun, from 7:00 AM
events.description: Experience the vibrant Eumundi Markets, a recurring community fixture offering live local music, artisan stalls, food, and a creative atmosphere. Open on Wednesday (small markets) and Saturday (main markets).

events.title: Banana Bender Pub – Thursday Trivia Night
events.description: Join "Trivia chaos with Michelle" every Thursday for a fun, competitive trivia night at the Banana Bender Pub, with a special burger and chips offer. A great way to socialize and test your knowledge.

events.title: The Station SC – Live Events & Skate Sessions
events.description: The Station SC is a hub for various live events, including national/international music acts and skate park sessions/lessons. Check their website directly for a full schedule of their upcoming events this week.

events.title: Norton Music Factory / Venue 114 – Live Music
events.description: Check the websites for Norton Music Factory (Caloundra) and Venue 114 (Bokarina) for their specific live music lineups and events occurring within the 15–21 June period.

events.title: Noosa Organic Community Garden – Friday Morning Volunteering
events.description: Participate in organic vegetable, herb, and fruit gardening activities at the Noosa Organic Community Garden. New members are welcome to this grounded, community-oriented outdoor event.
